searchText: 👋 hey and thus falls gitter Die gitter die! ahem. Sorry. did we solve the "how do we keep ACD publicly accessible" problem? <@!191378736254287874> is looking into "a tool that exports Discord messages as HTML we can post to a web server so people can have a read only look into the server" gitter is dead long live discord finally bring all protocol coordination to one location yessssss I have announced on the ACD Gitter that we are migrating to Discord and sent the invite link. 🎉 As part of this migration, will the EIPs channel move over too? I believe that we will make EIP specific channels under the "eth1" category Will there be a "catchall" channel for EIP discussions (EIPIP, EIPs w/o channels, questions about process, etc)? I think it's valuable to have a place that the community can connect with editors <@543900561460822016> 👍 👍 I'm a fan of starting with a single EIP channel, and then we can break it apart as needed. Based on the Gitter channel, do you think there is an obvious win for breaking apart <@!543900561460822016>? I understand the desire for separate EIP channels, but right now I think 1559 is the only EIP that I'm aware of that would really benefit from a separate channel. As some of the 1.x work solidifies as EIPs maybe it will make sense to make more channels, but I think 1 channel plus the 1559 channel is totally acceptable <@543900561460822016> let's start small with just this channel and see about making an EIP specific channel later. I think it's a good idea personally, but want people to get acclimated to discord first. There is already a 1559 channel (<#692078615269212180>). I think a lot of the "big EIPs" have one: Account Abstraction, Code Merkleization, ReGenesis, etc. We also have Magicians threads for most all EIPs. And Gitter EIP channel is currently used for coordination between EIP authors and editors. I'm not sure what we gain by moving it. i'm not sure why we wouldn't deprecate that channel on gitter at the same time we deprecate the ACD channel -- AFAICT, they receive the most traffic and almost everyone in the EIP channel also follow the ACD channel
